body: REQUIRED from the DM-270 final review (orchestrator, this run): `reorderedEvents` (src/core/repo/importer.ts:633-643) refuses a legitimate double-fork recovery on a third machine (repro: A s1; B r1 pushed, C pulls r1#1; A keeps ours, B renumbers s1#1 r1#2; A records s2; C numbers r1#3 and pushes; B keeps ours; A renumbers s2#3; C rejects forever). Fix: restrict the check to status events (add `event.kind === 'status'` to the `arriving` filter at :637 — only the owner records statuses and forkedStatuses refuses a status fork); keep the reversed-five refusal; add this A/B/C sequence as a test. Also clean up now-orphaned scratch/DM-184, DM-186, DM-188, DM-189, DM-190 world.ts (their importers DM-187/DM-191 scratch were deleted by DM-272).
